items.title: Monde noir sous VIctory : ray tracing (BVH), masques de lanes, composition finale

Death Stranding DC used to hang on a black screen ("Unable to retrieve prefetch list"). With this it gets to the menu, you can start a new game, the loading goes to 100 %, then it crashes when going in game.

What was missing:
- `sceAmprCommandBufferSetBuffer`: the game calls it with the same buffer before each read it adds. We reset the offset every time, so only the last read ran and most archives looked empty. Setting a buffer that is still attached now returns EBUSY and keeps what's queued. It's only refused if we attached it ourselves, so junk left in a recycled object doesn't block it.
- AMM command buffer constructor/destructor + MapDi

items.note:
Re-lands the PFSC (compressed PFS) decompression work from `6504565`, which was reverted after CI run #338 failed at Configure on all three platforms.

**Root cause of the CI failure:** the vendored `3rdparty/zlib` shipped `zconf.h.in` but not `zconf.h`. zlib's own `.gitignore` lists `/zconf.h` as a generated artifact, so `git add` silently skipped it. Local builds passed because the file existed on disk from the source tarball; CI's fresh clone died at `zlib/CMakeLists.txt:50` (`file(READ ${zlib_SOURCE_DIR}/zconf.h)` - no such file).

**Fix in this PR:**
